<<0+2>> note: resumed "Orchestrate cockpit fleet work" (CawCo orchestrator; /home/bewinxed/cockpit; hub obelisk-of-light; Mac Omars-MacBook-Pro). Confirm host first (/proc/1/cmdline not bwrap; cawco-hub active). Owner rules: robust fix, honest caveat, no fallbacks/unit tests/shims; UI advisor→preview→pick→build. Live: nightly 3238, TestFlight 20261015.3. Pending: owner picks, Mac scroll gate, Caw dirty files, retire worktrees. work: b7c9d8c2 ios-scroll-up waits for Mac load <20 (48109ebbc); nightly 3238 published, 27/27 PASS; Unii to restart in place.
<<2+2>> work: .config#c46010fc: 3238 installed on both machines via auto-update (obelisk 13:46:29Z, Mac 13:47:25Z), OpenCode 2.0.29 both, hub :3456; retiringKeepers still hold sessions (obelisk 3232 ×78). Unii: restarting in place (continue_session worked, NUL transcript damage fixed); owner picks pending: folder-tabs, caw-dock, routines, Caw's folder, OpenCode backups. Then checked it runs on host, not sandbox, and repo state.
<<8+2>> echo: delegates: cockpit-7c34546f waiting (tabs preview :5199, hold/tabs-svg 89c0824ff); c3201594 running (webkit-caw probe 5/7); a4e27882 running (two-pane dashboard); b2a591a2 running (OpenCode pin); done 24bdfe4f, 3eaedef2, e4cddd10, b6132a26, b7c9d8c2; cancelled aff64726. tool: Bash ls .out, apps/dashboard/.impeccable, git fetch origin/main.
<<10+2>> echo: .out is a 131-byte file (Oct 15 15:09); .impeccable holds config.json hook.cache.json; origin/main head 48109ebbc "ios-scroll-up: wait for a quiet Mac before each scroll pass". tool: Bash loop checking six spent workspaces (24bdfe4f 3eaedef2 e4cddd10 b6132a26 aff64726 b7c9d8c2) for ahead/dirty.
<<12+2>> echo: all six worktrees /home/bewinxed/.worktrees/cockpit-<id> ahead=0 dirty=0 (nothing unlanded). unii: all six clean and fully on main, so removing them.
<<16+2>> tool: Bash checked what survived removal in cockpit-24bdfe4f and cockpit-b7c9d8c2. echo: after rm -rf they still contain opencode.jsonc, opencode.json, .vscode, .opencode; lsattr shows only 'e' (not immutable), so not attr-locked.
<<22+2>> tool: Bash grep for retire/archive logic in packages/hub/src and stand-ins callers in packages/agent. echo: hub files stream.ts, work-items.ts, server.ts, caw.ts, workflows/steps.ts, db/index.ts; checkout-exclude.ts:70 BLOCK_END "# cawco: end of stand-ins"; boundary.ts:154 imports ./stand-ins.
<<44+2>> tool: curl POST http://127.0.0.1:3456/api/workspaces/24bdfe4f-daae-48cc-a201-70eac3b3773d/archive. echo: HTTP 200, state "archived", branch ws/24bdfe4f, path /home/bewinxed/.worktrees/cockpit-24bdfe4f; folder now gone.
<<46+2>> unii: That worked: workspace archived and folder gone; doing the other five the same way. tool: Bash loop looks up ids in ~/.local/share/cawco/cawco.db for 3eaedef2 e4cddd10 b6132a26 aff64726 b7c9d8c2, POSTs archive, prints HTTP and folder, df.
<<48+2>> echo: all five archive calls returned HTTP 409 and folders remain; / is 97% used (54G free of 1.8T). tool: Bash re-ran archive for 3eaedef2 to read the 409 reason.
<<50+2>> echo: 409 reason: workspace 3eaedef2-a4ae-451a-bece-c47575606c2d holds 1 entry of its own in a folder that is no git clone (49 KB); not archived, nothing deleted. Land/push work, or archive with discard: true, which saves commits/changes to a carry in ~/.cawco/carries. tool: Bash loop POSTing {"discard":true} for the five.
<<54+2>> echo: leftover folder holds ./opencode.jsonc ./opencode.json ./.bashrc ./.bash_profile ./.ripgreprc ./.claude/skills/review-attempt/SKILL.md plus a 12K .git with hooks and modules dirs only. tool: Bash grep for the archive guard and review-attempt skill placement in packages.
<<60+2>> tool: git grep on origin/main for archive guard. echo: "is not a git clone any more" at boundary-host.ts:255 and boundary.ts:1534; stand-ins.ts:264 (noRepositoryAt), :321 (removeStandIns husk comment); core/src/harness.ts:1830 "N entries of its own in a folder that is no git clone"; workspace.ts:798 strays comment.
<<62+2>> tool: read origin/main workspace.ts 740-860 and stand-ins.ts 255-345. echo: closeClone throws "was not archived: its clone holds …" if nonempty without carryHeld; else writeCarryInside via ensureBoundary (needs clone), moves carry, closes boundary, README, removes path; husk log when strays===0; straysIn counts non-stand-in entries; removeStandIns skips husks.
<<68+2>> echo: read fleet.ts: Sidecar placedSkills (`<name>@<place id>` → cwd, name, hash), placeSkill (fails if cwd missing "is not on this machine"; writes skill, excludeFromCheckout; skips folder's own skill), syncPlacedSkills (places, removes unplaced unless edited via treeHash).
<<70+2>> echo: delegate started: instance fcdafab0-82aa-4fdc-be2e-3ea2679548e8, work item 5d062a96-6d20-4c59-a5e8-37b31bc30cbc, workspace dfbe4033-89f8-41a9-bb6b-087a6d9b50cf (/home/bewinxed/.worktrees/cockpit-dfbe4033, ws/dfbe4033). Leaf; report after acceptance checks; guide via handoff("fcdafab0-…"). tool: memory_note: retire via archive API, never delete folders.
<<74+2>> echo: workspaces table schema (id, machine_id, repo_root, path, branch, state default 'active', ports, created_by_instance_id, created_at, boundary_pid, base, checks_for, tmp). tool: sqlite3 listing active obelisk (d04ca118428001f1) workspaces with item states, saved to /tmp/ws-active.txt.
<<76+2>> echo: 74 active obelisk workspaces, most done/cancelled/failed; running: 5dc65ac1 (OpenCode session lost on restart), 7c34546f, c3201594, a4e27882, b2a591a2, dfbe4033; husks 3eaedef2 e4cddd10 b6132a26 aff64726 b7c9d8c2 still active. tool: sqlite query of this session's idle workspaces to /tmp/ws-mine.txt.
<<78+2>> echo: 12 retire candidates under /home/bewinxed/.worktrees/cockpit-<8hex>: c6b56d26, 95a77461, 854b37f4, e65cb17d, 527a4ea7, 9edbc6d0, 4e129ba9, a7713fe9, d1907cd7, f037cc8c, c04ef394, cf58f5c7. tool: Bash checking each for no-clone / ahead / dirty.
<<82+2>> tool: archived five clean workspaces via hub. echo: 4e129ba9 HTTP 409 (2 entries, no git clone, 53 KB); d1907cd7 HTTP 502 ("[sessiond] signal failed: ... boundary-b34695b5-...-50395abb is not alive"); f037cc8c, c04ef394, cf58f5c7 HTTP 200, folders gone. /home free 61G (97%).
